talk.title: Build Apps Without Coding Using Gemini and Google AI Studio
talk.description: Through a few simple searches and proper structuring, you can create fully functional applications without knowing how to program and without technical debt.

speaker.name: David Martinez
speaker.title: CTO Inforrada - Microsoft MVP Foundry
speaker.bio:
Hi! I'm David. Sometimes a speaker, sometimes a listener, and always interested in web technologies. I work on complex projects involving anything related to API's & AI. I am Microsoft MVP in Foundry

Also, I am a co-organizer of GDG Ponferrada and Global AI Ponferrada.
